newsHighlights.title: Xi: Build more 'China Services' brands
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi Jinping called for advancing the high-quality development and international branding of China's service sector.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席呼吁推动中国服务业高质量发展，并建立国际品牌形象。

newsHighlights.title: CIFTIS 2026: Which sector takes the lead over next 5 years?
newsHighlights.summary: The China International Fair for Trade in Services 2026 in Beijing spotlights future-leading sectors within the 15th Five-Year Plan period.
newsHighlights.translation: 2026年中国国际服务贸易交易会在北京举行，重点探讨在‘十五五’规划期间将引领未来的行业。

newsHighlights.title: China shakes, stirs Asia's best bars list
newsHighlights.summary: Chinese bartenders and cocktail bars are gaining increasing recognition and climbing the ranks of Asia's top lists.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国调酒师和鸡尾酒吧正获得越来越多的认可，在亚洲顶级榜单上排名不断攀升。

newsHighlights.title: The Pinglu Canal: Through the Mountains to the Sea
newsHighlights.summary: This report details the construction of the major Pinglu Canal infrastructure project connecting inland waterways to the sea.
newsHighlights.translation: 该报道详细介绍了连接内河水道与大海的重大基础设施项目——平陆运河的建设。

quote.quote: Twenty years from now you will be more disappointed by the things you didn't do than by the ones you did do. So throw off the bowlines. Sail away from the safe harbor. Catch the trade winds in your sails. Explore. Dream. Discover.
quote.author: Mark Twain
quote.translation: 二十年后，让你感到失望的不是你做过的事，而是你没做的事。所以，解开绳索，驶离安全的港湾，扬帆乘风。去探索，去梦想，去发现。
quote.explanation: 这句名言鼓励人们勇于行动、探索世界，不要因犹豫而错过体验生活和文化的机会，与旅行和开拓精神的主题完美契合。

vocabulary.translation: 习近平主席呼吁打造更多‘中国服务’品牌。

vocabulary.example: CIFTIS 2026 explores which service sector may lead development over the next five years.
vocabulary.translation: 2026年服贸会探讨未来五年哪个服务行业可能引领发展。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻《CIFTIS 2026: Which sector takes the lead...》，特指服务贸易中的不同细分领域。

vocabulary.translation: 平陆运河是一项连接内陆地区与海洋的重大基础设施工程。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻《The Pinglu Canal: Through the Mountains to the Sea》，描述运河作为基础设施项目。

vocabulary.example: China's rich and diverse cultural offerings attract millions of tourists each year.
vocabulary.translation: 中国丰富多元的文化体验每年吸引数百万游客。
vocabulary.newsContext: 与新闻主题'文化与旅行'紧密相关，体现在中国旅游产品和服务的多样性上。

vocabulary.example: Cultural exchange programs are vital for fostering mutual understanding among nations.
vocabulary.translation: 文化交流项目对于促进国家间的相互理解至关重要。
vocabulary.newsContext: 在新闻《BRICS: Building Bridges》等涉及国际合作与交流的报道中隐含此概念。

vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻《Xi to attend BRICS summit in New Delhi》，指国家领导人参加的高层会议。

vocabulary.example: BRICS cooperation aims to deliver more practical benefits to the peoples.
vocabulary.translation: 金砖合作旨在为各国人民带来更多实实在在的利益。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻《BRICS: Building Bridges》，形容合作带来的实际好处。

vocabulary.example: The construction of the Pinglu Canal will significantly boost regional logistics and tourism.

vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻《The Pinglu Canal: Through the Mountains to the Sea》，核心报道对象。

vocabulary.example: The list showcases the best cocktail bars across the Asian continent.

vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻《China shakes, stirs Asia's best bars list》，指提供饮品和社交场所的酒吧。

vocabulary.example: Chinese bartenders are gaining increasing recognition on the international stage.
vocabulary.translation: 中国调酒师在国际舞台上正获得越来越多的认可。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻《China shakes, stirs Asia's best bars list》，描述中国调酒行业获得的赞誉和地位。

pattern.pattern: Subject + call(s) for + (sb/sth) + to do sth
pattern.example: President Xi Jinping has called for the breaking of new ground in the high-quality development of China's service sector.
pattern.translation: 习近平主席呼吁在中国服务业高质量发展中开拓新局面。
pattern.usage: 这是一个正式的倡议或呼吁句型，常用于新闻、演讲和政策文件中，表示号召某人或某方采取行动。

grammar.title: 动名词短语作主语
grammar.explanation: 在正式英语和新闻英语中，常用动名词短语（v-ing phrase）作为句子的主语，以强调一个动作或过程。
examples: Breaking new ground in service sector development is a key national strategy.
Building more 'China Services' brands requires innovation and quality control.

pronunciation.tips: 注意中间的 /æ/ 音，发音时嘴巴张开，舌位较低，类似中文'安'但更短促有力。结尾的 /d/ 音要轻。
examples: Building a strong international brand takes years of effort.
This brand is synonymous with quality and luxury.

reading.title: New Horizons: China's Service Sector Takes Center Stage
reading.content: China is making significant strides in elevating its service sector to global prominence. At the recent CIFTIS 2026 fair in Beijing, discussions focused on which service industries will lead growth during the 15th Five-Year Plan period. This push for high-quality development aligns with President Xi Jinping's call to build more 'China Services' brands. Beyond traditional trade, China's cultural influence is also rising. The country's diverse culinary and mixology scene is now making waves, with Chinese bars and bartenders climbing Asia's best-of lists. This cultural vibrancy complements major infrastructure projects like the Pinglu Canal, designed to connect inland resources with the sea, boosting both logistics and tourism. Together, these developments in branding, infrastructure, and cultural exchange are crafting a new narrative for China on the world stage, inviting more global interaction and exploration.
reading.translation: 中国正在大力提升其服务业的全球影响力。在北京举行的2026年服贸会上，讨论的焦点是'十五五'规划期间哪些服务行业将引领增长。这一推动高质量发展的举措，与习近平主席关于打造更多'中国服务'品牌的号召一脉相承。除了传统贸易，中国的文化影响力也在上升。中国多样化的餐饮和调酒界正掀起波澜，中国的酒吧和调酒师在亚洲最佳榜单上的排名不断攀升。这种文化活力与平陆运河等重大基础设施项目相辅相成。平陆运河旨在连接内陆资源与海洋，促进物流和旅游业。总的来说，这些在品牌建设、基础设施和文化交流方面的发展，正在全球舞台上塑造中国的新叙事，邀请更多的全球互动与探索。
reading.sourceNote: 本文综合改编自今日有关CIFTIS、'中国服务'品牌建设、平陆运河以及中国酒吧业发展的多条新闻报道。
